key_insight: A2D2 provides a unified reward-guided fine-tuning framework for any-length discrete diffusion by jointly learning insertion and unmasking policies plus a quality-based decoding schedule.
engineering_relevance: It enables controllable sequence generation with flexible output length while improving reward optimization, accuracy, and decoding robustness beyond fixed-length or inference-only guidance methods.
method: Derives the Radon-Nikodym derivative for joint insertion-unmasking path measures.
Introduces Adaptive Joint Decoding (AJD) loss to optimize path measures toward the reward-tilted distribution.
Uses tractable insertion and unmasking quality signals to reduce decoding error and guide inference scheduling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical gains in reward optimization, generation flexibility, and accuracy compared with prior fine-tuning and inference-time guidance baselines.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate quality estimation and a valid path-measure formulation, so implementation stability may be sensitive to model calibration and schedule design.
paper_title: A2D2: Fine-Tuning Any-Length Discrete Diffusion for Adaptive Decoding
